pages.text: Start small. A 3x3 floor with walls two blocks high is a perfectly valid smeltery and is cheap enough to build with your first batch of seared bricks.
Lay a solid seared-brick floor, raise the walls, add one tank for fuel, place a drain, and set the controller in a wall. Right-click the controller to open it.
A small smeltery melts only a few items at a time, but it is enough to cast your first metal tool parts. Expand it later as you gather more seared brick.
